lines.text: Why does a clicky pen STAY out after one click?
Fine. Inside, there's a spring on the ink tube, always pushing it back up.
Click, and the button shoves a little part called the cam down past some stops.
It's plastic with angled teeth. Every press, the teeth twist it a little.
The spring pushes back, it twists again... and catches on a short step. Tip stays out.
Next press, it twists into a long slot instead. The spring wins. Tip goes in.
So it's not remembering anything. It's just turning.
Round and round. Out, in, out, in.
That's why I can't stop clicking it in meetings.
That's why everyone in the meeting hates you.
Two clicks. One going down, one as it locks. And now you know.
